author: Xem Studio
attribution: iPhone 16 Pro body by Xem Studio, licensed CC BY 4.0. Original geometry downloaded unchanged; any later positioning is an assembly transform.
source_basis: Author states geometry was reconstructed from Apple's accessory dimensional drawing, including corner-profile points, edge profile and camera dimensions. This is not an Apple-issued STEP model or a measured physical handset.

native_coordinate_notes.orientation_hint: For the V6 exported assembly coordinates, rotate 180 degrees about Y and translate to the case centre; then determine the axial seating offset from the case inner surface. For rear-view review coordinates, also undo the exported Y reflection.

limitations: The author explicitly approximates the camera plateau corner outline, which is not dimensioned in the cited drawing.
Actual downloaded STEP has no width beyond 71.45 mm; the nominal 0.45 mm button protrusions are therefore not represented as external button solids.
Only three analytic cylindrical faces exist, corresponding to the main camera rings. Small sensors and flash should use the official drawing for their detailed keep-outs.
The source index.json still names an older envelope file; the body files were obtained from the direct links on the current model page and independently measured.
Use for initial envelope and camera-height checks. Simplified camera-island corners and omitted controls cannot validate the complete real handset fit.
